thread:
kevin: Quick report: sampleapp shows duplicate token refreshes on Android when using OkHttp Authenticator; some calls hang/cancel.

anya: Did you try a singleflight/mutex pattern in an interceptor?

marta: Authenticator runs on network threads and can spin up concurrent refreshes. Interceptor + Mutex usually fixes it.

kevin: Tried Mutex and retry-once; fixed duplicates but still saw occasional "stream allocation still active" warnings on older emulators.

anya: Workarounds: move refresh to interceptor, close response bodies (`.use {}`), avoid `call.clone()` for retries, optionally call `connectionPool.evictAll()` on token rotation.

marta: We'll add a short note + code snippet to the Android guide and update the sampleapp.

ci-bot: build/sampleapp #858 passed (8m)

kevin: Thanks — I'll open the PR with minimal changes and a tiny repro script for Pixel 3A Android 11.

anya: Perfect, that should help reduce onboarding friction.
